wiki.title: Dagmara Avelar
wiki.extract: Dagmara "Dee" Avelar is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 85th district. She has held the position since January 13, 2021. The 85th district, located in the Chicago area, covers all or parts of Bolingbrook, Crest Hill, Fairmont, Lemont, Lockport, Naperville, Romeoville, and Woodridge. As of 2025, she serves as an Assistant Majority Leader.
